title: incident-bot: SLO/runbook metadata enrichment + slo-toolkit oncall helpers
author: Priya Nair
description: Motivation: on-call responders need faster, contextual SLO hints and direct runbook links in incident-bot messages; slo-toolkit should expose small helper utilities to generate runbook metadata and SLO summary snippets for other tooling. This PR adds runbook metadata enrichment in incident-bot, SLO hint generation utilities in slo-toolkit, and on-call helpers to improve the signal-to-noise of automated diagnostics. Key changes: 1) incident-bot now attaches runbook metadata (runbook id, primary owner, severity mapping, associated SLOs) to alert messages so UIs and message renderers can surface one-click links and on-call hints; 2) slo-toolkit adds OncallHelpers.GenerateSloHint and a lightweight SLO summary payload used by incident-bot and alerts; 3) small docs updates (docs/runbooks.md) and Helm defaults for enablement; 4) tests: unit and integration tests added to cover enrichment and end-to-end runbook linking. Backwards compatibility: enrichment is opt-in via config flag (ENABLE_RUNBOOK_METADATA) defaulting to false for existing installs; message schema extension is additive and falls back to previous behavior when disabled. Rollout plan: deploy incident-bot with feature flag off; enable in staging and validate alert messages for a week; flip flag in canary and ramp to production. Checklist: IMPLEMENTED tests, docs updated, helm values added, migration not required, metrics added for enrichment hit-rate.

release_notes: Add opt-in runbook metadata enrichment to incident-bot messages; add slo-toolkit OncallHelpers.GenerateSloHint utility; docs and Helm values to enable feature. Impact: opt-in only, no DB migration required, improves on-call UX by surfacing runbook links and SLO hints.
notes: Performance: added a small in-memory TTL cache for runbook lookups to avoid hot-path DB calls; added metric incident_bot.runbook_enrichment.hit_rate. Operational: toggle ENABLE_RUNBOOK_METADATA in config; monitor enrichment_hit_rate and enrichment_latency.
